headline: DeepSeek's v4.1 flash holds the all-time token-share record for day 2 as its provider nears 40%
summary: deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 is sitting on an all-time record of 28.9% of tokens, and it's now day 2 of that streak. Its provider, DeepSeek, holds 39.9% overall and has gained 17.5% over 30 days, while DeepSeek and OpenAI together hold 50.0%.
highlights: OpenAI's gpt-5.6-luna climbed 18 places over seven days to rank 5.
MiniMax's minimax-m3.1-flash jumped 12 spots over seven days to rank 7.
Three newcomers arrived: minimax-m3 at rank 34, claude-4.5-sonnet at 45, and gemma-4-26b-a4b-it at 49.
Dropouts: gpt-6-luna-decisions (last ranked 41), gpt-oss-120b (48), and solar-pro4 (50).
